Every default and observable-specific facet now declares event_stage or typed measurement_window cardinality scope. Repeated same-facet facts require distinct scope and facet-group identities, so R02, R03, R10, R12, R15, R16, R20, and R21 stage/window trajectories are representable without relaxing same-scope exclusivity or evidence-unit controls.

The observable_response required fields provide collections for facet groups, windows, stages, edges, and evidence units but no required collection or other normative containment for value_assertion, component_assertion, absence_condition, or source_provenance records, even though every substantive record refers to those objects by ID. In addition, component_assertion carries neither event_stage_id nor evidence_unit_id and lacks the value_assertion rule requiring its ID to occur in exactly one event stage. The contract therefore does not mechanically guarantee resolvable assertion/provenance records or a unique stage/evidence-unit binding for retained hybrid components; a nominal implementation could omit them or attach one component to multiple stages, silently losing or corrupting the stage-preserving evidence identity the invariants require.
